desc: This bag looks and functions exactly like a normal **Bag of Holding**, with double the interior capacity of up to **1000 pounds** and **128 cubic feet**.
This capacity comes at a cost: the **Bag of Withholding** feels unappreciated and won’t open unless reassured.

When attempting to retrieve any item, the player must succeed on a **DC 14 Persuasion check**, or the bag clamps shut. Each failure increases the DC by **1**. Success grants access for **1 minute** and resets the DC to **14**. The DC always resets to **14 at dawn**.
• Base DC **14** Persuasion check to retrieve items
• Each failed attempt increases the DC by **1**
• DC always resets to **14 at dawn**
